stories.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after visiting dignitaries passed through
stories.summary: Ukraine's state rail operator said a Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border on Sunday, shortly after senior visiting dignitaries, including former UK prime minister Boris Johnson and Sweden's former premier, had passed through. BBC reported the strike came as Johnson and top European officials left the station, with Johnson questioning what "warped logic" drove the attack on a stationary locomotive on the Polish border, while Al Jazeera reported Poland and Ukraine accused Russia of "escalation" after the strikes near the border.
